title: Glessner House matched to Kevin's new photographs
items: The rock-faced granite varies like the real wall: some stones pillow over a sharp lower lip, some are smoother.
The carving over the front door bulges in two levels, and its field grows in leafy scrolls.
The coach house on 18th Street has green diagonal-boarded doors with a man door, a shut green loft door, and a driveway over the curb.
The alley dormer has its boarded hood with curved cheeks over a green loft door.
At the alley the courtyard wall stands tall to the brick edge, beside a framed green gate, a humped pier cap and a guard stone.
A bronze 35 plate sits on the 18th Street entry.
